$comment: Licences of everything the app downloads or bundles that cargo-deny can't see (model weights, Python packages, executables). Policy is enforced by src/utils/__tests__/runtimeLicenses.spec.ts; notices are shown in the app.

exceptions.reason: Optional engine the user installs on request. The runner code is MIT; only the downloaded weights are non-commercial. Accepted as long as the app shows the licence notice wherever the model is used.
